description: This file declares the ProxyConfigServiceLinux class and its nested classes, which implement system proxy configuration retrieval for Linux environments, including methods for fetching proxy settings from environment variables, gconf, gsettings, or kioslaverc, and managing change notifications.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceLinux
classes.description: Implements system proxy configuration retrieval for Linux, managing notifications and settings from environment variables, gconf, gsettings, or kioslaverc.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceLinux::Delegate
classes.description: Handles the actual fetching of proxy settings, change notifications, and observer management, encapsulated within a reference-counted class.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceLinux::SettingGetter
classes.description: Abstract interface for obtaining proxy configuration settings from system sources, supporting initialization, notifications, and retrieval of various setting types.

methods.name: ProxyConfigServiceLinux(std::unique_ptr<base::Environment>, const NetworkTrafficAnnotationTag&)
methods.description: Constructor for testing with custom environment getter and traffic annotation.

methods.name: SetupAndFetchInitialConfig
methods.description: Initializes the service, fetching initial proxy settings and setting up notifications.

methods.name: OnCheckProxyConfigSettings
methods.description: Triggers a re-fetch of proxy settings based on current system configuration.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to be notified of proxy configuration changes.

methods.name: GetLatestProxyConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent proxy configuration.

methods.name: PostDestroyTask
methods.description: Posts a task to safely destroy the service and stop notifications.

methods.name: OnDestroy
methods.description: Stops change notifications and cleans up resources.
